Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The Bangladesh players stride out to the middle. Followed by Rahmat Shah and Riaz Hassan who walk out to open for Afghanistan. Mustafizur Rahman to start with the new ball. Well usually, Rahmanullah Gurbaz opens for Afghanistan, but he suffered a injury in the field and since then, he is being getting nursed. Wonder if he will be able to come in and bat down the order.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then. Before the game, the Afghan skipper, Hashmatullah Shahidi, said they will try to restrict the hosts below 260, but well that is not the case anymore and the Afghan batters need to do some serious batting if they are to chase down a target of 307 runs.

Afghanistan players lacked determination in the field. The third-wicket stand took them for a ride and the body language of the Afghan players said it all to be honest. The spinning trio could not do a lot of damage on this surface, the batters scored runs quite easily off them and only Rashid Khan managed to take a wicket amongst them. Fareed Ahmad picked up a brace, while Fazalhaq Farooqi took a wicket. It was not a very good day with the ball for Afghanistan and they bowled a total of 18 wides.

Bangladesh’s top order had to step up after a dismal performance in the first ODI and well they did just that. The top order flourished today, and the hosts were never under pressure, unlike the last game. The openers started off cautiously and the hosts lost Tamim Iqbal inside the first Powerplay. Although, Shakib Al Hasan and Liton Das held their nerves and built a solid foundation for their side with a 45-run stand. After this wicket, another batting pair made a record for Bangladesh in this series, by racking up 202 runs for the third wicket. It was the excellence of Liton Das mixed with some experience of Mushfiqur Rahim, who were dictating the terms with the blade. Das went onto make 136 runs while Rahim scored 86. They both slipped out on consecutive deliveries in the 47th over but the damage had already been done. In the final three overs, Afif Hossain and Mahmudullah applied the finishing touches and made sure to cross the 300-run mark.

Woah! What an enthralling innings did we just witness. A bit of déjà vu for Afghanistan one might say. It was the seventh-wicket stand then, while now it was the third-wicket stand for Bangladesh that took the game away from the visitors. Without a doubt, Bangladesh will be the happier side going into the break.
Full ball, outside off. Mahmudullah drags it to deep cover and manages only a single. Fantastic last over from Fazalhaq Farooqi, just 4 runs off it! Bangladesh end with 306/4.
On a length, around middle. Afif Hossain whips it off his pads towards deep square leg for a run.
Play and a miss! A slower bumper, outside off. Afif Hossain stays back to cut but he fails to get bat on ball. Good change of pace from Fazalhaq Farooqi.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Mahmudullah miscues his pull wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder for one run.
A slower ball, full and outside off. Mahmudullah shuffles across and looks to heave it on the leg side but he misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Afif Hossain cuts it to deep cover for a single.

DROPPED! A tough one for the fielder! A full ball, on off. Afif Hossain moves across in his crease and looks to scoop it over the short fine leg fielder. He gets the toe end of the bat and the ball goes towards the fielder there. He is a bit late to react, puts in a dive forward but puts it down. A single taken.
A short ball, around off. Mahmudullah pulls it along the ground towards deep square leg for one run.
Mahmudullah advances down the track so Ahmad bangs it into the deck. Mahmudullah fails to get any blade on it as he tries to pull it hard.
Wide! A slower bumper, above the batter's head. Mahmudullah looks to pull but he misses. 300 comes up for Bangladesh!
A full ball, outside off. Afif Hossain drives it to deep cover for a single.
Wide! Full and too wide, outside off. Afif Hossain tries to cut but he misses. Wided! 17th wide of the innings!
A short ball, around off. Mahmudullah shuffles across and pulls it along the ground towards deep square leg for a run.
A slower ball, into the surface, on middle. Mahmudullah looks to tonk it over deep mid-wicket but he fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! Nicely done! Full and wide, outside off. Afif Hossain gets low and just caresses it through the point region to bag a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Mahmudullah looks to cut but it goes off the underedge behind the sticks and the batters sneak in a run.
A short ball, into the ribs, cramping the batter for room. Afif Hossain hops in his crease and nudges it to the leg side for a single.
Another ball, slower and shorter in length, on off. Afif Hossain mistimes his pull towards the short fine leg fielder. No run there.
A slower ball, into the wicket, outside off. Afif Hossain pulls it in front of square and collects a couple of runs.
A full ball, on off. Mahmudullah drills it to long on for a single.
Excellent running! On a length, around middle. Afif Hossain tucks it through mid-wicket and comes back for the second run. He is off the mark now.
Swing and a miss! Short of a length, outside off. Afif Hossain looks to cut but he misses.
Back of a length, around off. Afif Hossain stays back to block it.
Afif Hossain is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Two in two for Fareed Ahmad and both the set batters are back in the hut now! This was a short ball, outside off. Rahim stays back and looks to ramp it over the third man fence. He does not time it well and the ball goes in the air towards the third man fielder. Fazalhaq Farooqi settles under it and pouches it with ease. Fareed Ahmad is on a hat-trick now!
Commentary.Howout: c Fazalhaq Farooqi b Fareed Ahmad

Commentary.Commentary: Mahmudullah is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally, Afghanistan break the partnership and it is Fareed Ahmad who gets rid of the centurion! Another ball, slower and shorter in length, around off. Das stays back and looks to pull hard but it goes off the top edge, straight to Mujeeb Ur Rahman at deep square leg who makes no mistake. End of a brilliant innings from Das!
Commentary.Howout: c Mujeeb Ur Rahman b Fareed Ahmad

A full ball, on middle. Liton Das drags it towards deep mid-wicket and comes back for the second run. That brings up the 200-run stand between these two.
Fuller in length, outside off. Liton Das drags it to long on and comes back for the second run.
Another ball, slower and around off. Mushfiqur Rahim taps it towards point for a run.
A yorker-length ball, on middle. Das digs it out towards deep square leg for a single.
SIX! BANG! In the arc and it goes out of the park! A length ball, around middle. Das stays back, clears his front leg and whacks it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
A slower ball, on a length, around off. Liton Das looks to heave it away but he gets an inside edge towards the keeper.

A short ball, on off. Das pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full length, on leg. Rahim flicks it to long on for a single.

Slightly short and on off. Rahim guides it to third man for a single.
Length ball, on off. Das pushes it to cover for a single.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Mushfiqur Rahim works it to mid on for a single.
A length ball, on middle. Liton Das clips it to the leg side for a single.
SIX! BANG! Back of a length, on the body. Das swivels on the back foot and smokes it over the long on fence for a biggie.
FOUR! What a shot! A full-length ball, outside off. Liton Das comes down the track, adjusts himself in the end and slashes it through point for a boundary.
Floated, full, on off. Rahim gets low and sweeps it to short fine leg.
Full and outside off. Das leans in and drives it down the ground for one run.
On leg, Rahim nudges it to mid-wicket for another single.
Floated, full and on the pads. Das clips it through mid-wicket for one.

The ball goes through the gap towards the keeper. Rahim is way out of the crease but is able to get back in time as the keeper fails to gather it.

FOUR! Liton Das has started to open up now. Floated, full and on off. Liton Das makes room and drives it through covers for a boundary.
On the shorter side, outside off. Liton Das stands back and cuts it to deep point for one.
Fuller and on the pads. Rahim flicks it to square leg for one.

Quicker, outside off. Das tries to chase it but misses.

FOUR! Liton Das gets his TON in some fine fashion. Floated. full and outside off. Liton Das reaches out and slashes it through covers for a boundary. This is top class batting. This stand moves to 150 as well.
Tossed up, full and on off. Liton Das pushes it to cover.
Floated, full and outside off. Rahim drives it down the ground for a single.
Full and on off, blocked out.
End of Powerplay 2! Afghanistan can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the ring till the 50th over.
Floated, full and around leg. Rahim presses forward and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for one run.

Around middle. Mushfiqur Rahim gets forward and flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for one run.

Floated, on middle. Liton Das drills it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length, on middle. Mushfiqur Rahim clips it to the leg side for a single.

This is darted on the pads. Liton Das nudges it to the leg side for a run.

Fuller in length, on middle. Mushfiqur Rahim works it to long on for a run.

Short and wide outside off. Rahim punches it to point for a single.
Full and outside off. Rahim shuffles across, eases it down to long on for a single. A tidy over from Khan comes to an end.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Fuller and outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim opens the face of the bat late and guides it past short third man for a boundary. Mushfiqur Rahim showcasing his skills at the moment.
FOUR! Nicely played. Rahim is growing in confidence with every shot. Tossed up, just outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim gets low and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
Floated, full and on leg. Rahim defends it into the deck.
Fuller and on off. Rahim defends it back to the bowler.

A length ball, on off. Das defends it out solidly.
A full length ball, on off. Das works it back to the bowler off the bottom end.
FOUR! Top shot! A short ball, on middle and leg. Liton Das stays inside the crease, swivels and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

Back of a length, nipping in from outside off. Liton Das stays back and steers it down to third man for a single.

DRINKS! Bangladesh are going along nicely and Afghanistan haven't been upto the mark with the ball so far. The spinners haven't troubled the batters much and that has cost the tourists. Hashmatullah Shahidi and his troops must ensure that they break this partnership sooner rather than later if they are to restrict them somewhere around the 250-run mark.
Angled in, full and on the pads. Das gets it to the off side off the outer half.

A single as this is worked towards mid on.
Floated, full and outside off. Das leans forward and tries to defend it out inside the line. He gets beaten on the outside edge.
A length ball, on off. Das clips it to mid on and scampers across for a quick single. This is really good batting.
Fuller, on off. Rahim guides it towards point for a single.
On a length, outside off. Rahim cuts it through point for a brace.
WIDE! A length ball, angling down leg. Rahim leaves it alone. Wide called.
A length ball, angled into off. Mushfiqur Rahim stays inside the crease and defends it to point.
Slightly short and on off. Rahim defends it out watchfully.
A length ball, outside off. Das pushes it to the off side for a quick single.
Fuller, around off. Das pushes it through covers for a single. A good over for the hosts, 8 runs off it.
Full, on middle and leg. Rahim comes down the track and flicks it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Slapped! Short one, outside off. Rahim goes on his back foot and cuts it through point for a boundary.

Full and on leg. Rahim clips it to square leg for a single.
LEG BYE! A length ball, on the pads. Rahim tries to flick but misses, it rolls out of his pads. The batters cross for a leg bye.
Full length, outside off. Rahim steps across and defends it to the off side.
Length ball, on the stumps. Rahim defends it out solidly.
Length, on off. Das pushes it to cover for one more.
Full length, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim leans in and drives it towards cover. The fielder there dives to his left to make a half-stop. They take one.
A ripper to start the over with! Good-length ball, around off, it nips away off the deck. Mushfiqur Rahim shuffles across and tries to play away from his body but gets beaten.

Floated, full and outside off. Liton Das drives but finds the extra cover fielder.

FOUR! CUT AWAY! Shorter in length, outside off. Das rocks back and cuts it past the fielder at point for a boundary. Top shot from Liton Das!

Flatter ball, outside off. Das lets it through to the keeper.
On a length, around middle. Liton Das flicks it past the diving fielder at mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball, on middle. Mushfiqur Rahim eases it to long on for a run.

On a length, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim keeps it out.
A full ball, around leg. Liton Das clips it behind square on the leg side and settles for a run.

Rashid Khan appeals and the umpire raises his finger in no time. Huge moment in this game and Afghanistan are right back in this contest.

Azmatullah Omarzai comes into the attack now.
Width on offer, outside off, Shakib Al Hasan hangs back and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Short and outside off. Shakib Al Hasan goes on the back foot and cuts it to point.
Flaoted, full and on off. Shakib Al Hasan works it to mid off.
Fuller, on off. Das pushes it to cover with soft hands for a single.
WIDE! A googly which keeps low and slides down the leg side. Wide callled.
Fuller, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan drives it into covers for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Shakib Al Hasan hangs back and tries to chase it away but misses.
Length ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan works it to backward point for a single.
A length ball, on off. Das guides it to third man for one.
Back of a length, outside off, shaping away. Liton Das tries to chase it but misses.
Another full-length delivery, angled into the pads. Shakib Al Hasan gets his blade down a little late and inside-edges it to fine leg for a single.
Full length, around off, Fazalhaq Farooqi gets it into the left-hander. Shakib Al Hasan gets pinged on the pads. Fazalhaq Farooqi appeals but the umpire is unmoved.
A full-length ball, angled into the pads. Liton Das comes forward and flicks it through mid-wicket for three runs.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Liton Das cuts it towards point and settles for a single.
Leg bye! Another ball, drifting onto the pads. Shakib Al Hasan fails to defend and gets hit on his pad. The ball rolls to the leg side for a leg bye.
Tosses it up, around off. Shakib Al Hasan presses forward and blocks it solidly.
On a length, around off. Shakib Al Hasan blocks it off the front foot.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan lunges forward but leaves it in the end.
TWO LEG BYES! A length ball, on the pads. Shakib Al Hasan misses his nudge and the ball ricochets off his pads towards the fine leg region for two leg byes.
A yorker-length ball, around off. Liton Das sits back and digs it out back to the bowler.
A length ball, just outside off and angling way across the batter. Liton Das has a tentative poke at it and the ball beats his outside edge.
BEATEN! Good-length delivery, around off and curling away from the batter. Liton Das stays back to defend but the ball zips past his outside edge.
A similar delivery, outside off and shaping away from the batter. Das leaves it alone for the keeper to collect.
A full ball, angling across the batter. Liton Das shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan stays back and cuts it wide of third man for a single.
Flatter and quicker, on middle. Liton Das hangs back and keeps it out.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A quicker ball, drifting onto the pads. Liton Das covers the line of the ball and glances it past the short third man fielder for a boundary.
Fuller in length, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan eases it down to long on for a run.
Wide! A length ball, drifting down leg. Shakib Al Hasan lets it be and the umpire calls it wide.
On a length, around off. Shakib Al Hasan keeps it out.
An arm ball, coming back into the batter. Shakib Al Hasan tries to cut but gets cramped for room and underedges it to point.
Tossed up, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan prods and pushes it to cover.
Back of a length, outside off. Liton Das leaves it alone. 7 runs and a wicket off it.
Another ball, full and outside off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge towards the third man fielder for a single.
Excellent comeback from Farooqi! A full ball, outside off, enticing the batter to drive. Shakib Al Hasan looks for a booming drive through covers but the ball beats his outside edge.
FOUR! A gift from Fazalhaq Farooqi! A length ball, down leg. Shakib Al Hasan prods and just tickles it through the fine leg region for a boundary.
Review! Tamim Iqbal has opted for a review after being adjudged LBW! UltraEdge confirms that there is no bat involved. The Ball Tracker shows three reds and Tamim Iqbal is a goner.

OUT! LBW! Fazalhaq Farooqi strikes and this is a big wicket for Afghanistan! A length ball, jagging back in sharply from outside off. Tamim Iqbal looks to block but gets into a bit of tangle and misses. The ball hits him on his front pad and Fazalhaq Farooqi appeals. The umpire agrees but Tamim decides to review. The Ball Tracking indicates that the impact is with the umpire's call and wickets hitting. Bangladesh lose their first wicket.
A length ball, angling down leg. Tamim Iqbal tickles it towards fine leg for a brace.
FOUR! Deft touch! Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Liton Das hangs back and just guides it past the man at short third man for a boundary.
This is darted on the pads. Liton Das prods and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, going on with the angle from off. Tamim stays back and nudges it around the corner for a single.
A loopy ball, on middle. Tamim covers the line of the ball and defends.
Slower through the air, around off. Tamim Iqbal lunges forward to block.
Tosses it up, on middle. Tamim Iqbal blocks it out.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes into the attack.
FOUR! Nicely payed. Liton Das spoils a good over for Fazalhaq Farooqi with this boundary. A length ball, outside off. Das guides it down to third man for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Tamim Iqbal leaves it alone for the keeper.
A full length, on off. Tamim Iqbal flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, on off. Tamim Iqbal shuffles across and tucks it to square leg.
Fuller, wide outside off. Tamim Iqbal leans in and blocks it towards cover.
Full length, on off. Iqbal defends it out off his front foot.
Rahmanullah Gurbaz is walking off the field now.
A length ball, sliding down leg. Liton Das stays inside the crease and flicks it through square leg. The fielder gives it a chase and cuts it out in time. They take a couple.
Good length, on the stumps. Das hangs back and defends it to cover.
Length ball, outside off. Das looks to chase it but misses.
FOUR! And finally Liton Das gets off the mark. Slightly short and outside off. Liton Das hangs back and cuts it through the point region for a boundary.
Fareed Ahmad serves a full-length ball, outside off, shaping across the right-hander. Liton Das tries to have a poke at it but misses.
A length ball, on off. Liton Das walks down the track and blocks it out to cover.
Slight halt in play. Rahmanullah Gurbaz is getting some treatment on his knee. Might be only a niggle. Yes, the magic spray seems to have done the trick and we are good to go now.
Two dots in a row to end the over! Good length, outside off, shaping away. Tamim Iqbal tries to chase it but misses.
Length, on off, defended out solidly.

NOT OUT! Afghanistan lose a review and Bangladesh colllect a leg bye in the end. A full-length ball, on leg. Liton Das hangs back and tries to block it out but misses. He gets hit on his pads. Fazalhaq Farooqi appeals but the umpire is not interested. Afghanistan players have a chat and convince their skipper to take a review. Although, the Ball Tracking confirms it is pitching outside leg.
Review! Hashmatullah Shahidi opts for a review as Liton Das has been struck on his pad. No bat involved but the Ball Tracker shows that the ball was pitched outside leg and Afghanistan lose a review.
Das is standing outside the crease. It is a length ball, outside off, this one nips in a long way. Liton Das advances down the track and defends it out.
A length ball, outside off, shaping away a bit. Liton Das tries to defend it inside the line but misses.
FOUR BYES! A full-length ball, outside off, shaping away a long way. Rahmanullah Gurbaz dives but in vain. The ball races away to the third man fence. Byes given.
FOUR! Nicely played. Tamim Iqbal growing with every shot. A full-length ball, on the pads. Tamim Iqbal flicks it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Good length, outside off. Tamim Iqbal bends his knees and cuts it towards point.
FOUR! First runs off the blade for Bangladesh. Overpitched, on middle and leg. Tamim Iqbal leans forward and drives it past mid on for a boundary.
Length ball, on the stumps. Tamim Iqbal blocks it out watchfully.
Length ball, on off. Tamim Iqbal defends it to cover.
Fuller, on the pads. Tamim Iqbal stays inside the crease and tries to flick it away but misses.

FIVE WIDES! Fareed Ahmad starts with a loosener. A full-length ball, angled down leg. Tamim Iqbal leaves it alone. Rahmanullah Gurbaz dives to his right and fails to gather the ball with a full stretch. It races away to the fine leg fence.
Who will bowl from the other end? Fareed Ahmad it is.
LEG BYE! On a length, on the pads. Iqbal misses his flick to get rapped on the pads. The ball rolls towards square leg for a leg bye.
Short ball, outside off. Iqbal cuts it to point. Not in the gap though.
Good length, outside off. Tamim Iqbal leaves it alone for the keeper.
Length ball, on off, blocked out solidly.
WIDE! Touch short, outside off, shaping away. Tamim Iqbal shoulders his arms at it. Wide called.
Two dots in a row! Full length, outside off. Tamim Iqbal leans in and drives it into cover.
A length ball, outside off. Tamim Iqbal leaves it alone for the keeper.

We are set for the game to begin! The players have made their way out to the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das to open the batting for Bangladesh. Fazalhaq Farooqi will start proceedings with the ball. Here we go..

PITCH REPORT - Ed Rainsford is near the pitch. He says that bowling full on this pitch is very important. The pitch has a good covering of grass and the boundaries here are very short. Mentions that the ball will come on to the bat nicely and overall, it is a good cricketing surface.

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the skipper of Afghanistan, says that they wanted to bowl first anyways. Tells that they want to get early wickets and put some pressure on the opposition. Mentions that they have made three changes to their side.

Tamim Iqbal, the skipper of Bangladesh, is in for a chat. He says they will bat first. Says, he thinks Farooqi should get the credit for getting rid of the top order in their previous game. Mentions, the batters just need to apply themselves. Adds, they have no changes to their side and would aim to rack up 260 runs.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Riaz Hassan (In for Ibrahim Zadran), Rahmat Shah, Hashmatullah Shahidi (C), Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi, Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Fareed Ahmad (In for Yamin Ahmadzai), Fazalhaq Farooqi, Azmatullah Omarzai (In for Gulbadin Naib)..

Bangladesh (Unchanged playing XI) - Liton Das, Tamim Iqbal (C), Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Yasir Ali, Mahmudullah, Afif Hossain, Mehidy Hasan, Shoriful Islam, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Bangladesh. They have elected to BAT first.

Bangladesh pulled off a terrific win in the opening game of the series, courtesy their youngsters and Tamim and his troops would be looking to seal the series with one more game to go. Afghanistan, on the flip side, will look to put their best foot forward coming into this fixture as this is a must-win game for them. The hosts do start as favourites but one cannot rule out Afghanistan as they can destroy any opposition on their day. We are in for a cracker of a game so stay tuned for toss and team news.

Hello and a very warm welcome to the coverage of the 2nd ODI between Afghanistan and Bangladesh. The first game proved to be a thriller and we hope that this clash turns out be nothing short of that as Afghanistan seek for revival.
